panels.description: RAM utilisee : mesuree a l'interieur de la machine (node-exporter) quand disponible, sinon vue hyperviseur.

targets.expr: max by (id, name, node, type) (id:pve_cpu_usage_limit:max * on(id) group_left(name, node, type) id:pve_guest_info:max{template="0", node=~"$noeud"})
max by (id) (id:pve_memory_size_bytes:max and on(id) id:pve_guest_info:max{template="0", node=~"$noeud"})
max by (id) (id:pve_cpu_usage_ratio:max and on(id) id:pve_guest_info:max{template="0", node=~"$noeud"})
max by (id) (id:pve_up:max and on(id) id:pve_guest_info:max{template="0", node=~"$noeud"})

panels.title: Detail des VMs et LXC

targets.expr: count((id:pve_up:max == 0) and on(id) id:pve_guest_info:max{template="0", node=~"$noeud"}) or vector(0)

panels.description: Etat du quorum Corosync. Independant du filtre Noeud.
panels.title: Quorum cluster

targets.expr: count((id:pve_up:max == 1) and on(id) id:pve_guest_info:max{type="qemu", template="0", node=~"$noeud"}) or vector(0)
count((id:pve_up:max == 1) and on(id) id:pve_guest_info:max{type="lxc", template="0", node=~"$noeud"}) or vector(0)

panels.description: Nombre d'invites sans sauvegarde connue de Proxmox. Valeur cluster, independante du filtre Noeud.

panels.description: Memoire physique engagee sur le ou les noeuds. Pour la consommation reelle a l'interieur des VMs, voir le tableau de detail.

panels.description: vCPU attribues aux invites / coeurs physiques du noeud. Au-dela de 100%, le noeud promet plus de CPU qu'il n'en possede.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (id:pve_cpu_usage_limit:max * on(id) group_left(node) id:pve_guest_info:max{template="0", node=~"$noeud"}) / on(node) label_replace(id:pve_cpu_usage_limit:max{id=~"node/$noeud"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.*)")

targets.expr: sum by (node) (id:pve_memory_size_bytes:max * on(id) group_left(node) id:pve_guest_info:max{template="0", node=~"$noeud"}) / on(node) label_replace(id:pve_memory_size_bytes:max{id=~"node/$noeud"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.*)")
